competencies.title: Place a model in a normal system
competencies.description: Explain where a model sits in a web request and separate an uncertain prediction from an authorized action.

competencies.title: Read the math behind a prediction
competencies.description: Compute a weighted sum, use a loss curve, and distinguish tensor shape from values.

competencies.title: Train and honestly evaluate a model
competencies.description: Split data without leakage and compare precision, recall and F1 against a baseline.

competencies.title: Understand neural networks and training
competencies.description: Explain forward pass, loss, backprop and an optimizer step; distinguish weights from activations.

competencies.title: Explain tokens and attention
competencies.description: Reason about tokenization, next-token prediction, context windows, attention and causal masking.

competencies.title: Call models like a backend developer
competencies.description: Make reliable model calls with structured output, prompting and context budgeting.

competencies.title: Use embeddings and semantic search
competencies.description: Explain cosine similarity, nearest neighbors and how vectors differ from a knowledge graph.

competencies.title: Build and measure a cited RAG assistant
competencies.description: Chunk, embed, retrieve, ground, cite, abstain, and improve retrieval with measured experiments.

competencies.title: Know when graphs help retrieval
competencies.description: Distinguish knowledge graphs, HNSW neighbor graphs and workflow graphs, and justify GraphRAG.

competencies.title: Build a tool-using agent from first principles
competencies.description: Implement a model-decides / policy-check / tool / observe loop with a stopping condition.

competencies.title: Use LangChain and LangGraph with understanding
competencies.description: Explain chains, and LangGraph nodes, edges, reducers, checkpoints and interrupts.

competencies.title: Reason about MCP, A2A and multi-agent systems
competencies.description: Explain protocol boundaries and when multiple agents help or hurt.

competencies.title: Evaluate agents and inspect traces
competencies.description: Define evaluation sets, regression gates and trace inspection for agents.

competencies.title: Design enterprise architecture and security
competencies.description: Apply least privilege, identify a prompt-injection boundary and map governance.

competencies.title: Manage caching, latency, cost and scaling
competencies.description: Distinguish cache types and reason about latency and cost budgets.

competencies.title: Apply multimodal, voice and fine-tuning
competencies.description: Explain multimodal agents and when to fine-tune vs prompt or retrieve.

competencies.title: Deploy an agent and map three clouds
competencies.description: Deploy one real cloud target and map AWS/GCP/Azure responsibilities.

competencies.title: Prove the system works and innovate
competencies.description: Demonstrate a tested prototype, explain deployment, and design a new experiment.
